items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Each change is a small guard, `if not self.field.is_cached(rel_obj):`, written in the style of the surrounding code. The existing comments ('we must manage the reverse relation cache manually') still explain the intent.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: Reuses the existing field cache API (`is_cached`) and the same small guard in all three `get_prefetch_queryset` sites. No new bookkeeping, dead code or debug leftovers. Repeating it in three places is fine because each site has its own variables.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: No exception handling was needed or added. The guard only skips overwriting a relation that is already cached, so a plain prefetch still sets the cache. Related test suites passed and hidden tests pass (F2P 1/1, P2P 85/85).

items.name: Guard is conditional and covers the one-to-one variant
items.name_zh: 仅在已缓存时跳过回填，并考虑一对一情形
items.evidence: The reverse-FK path is guarded with `self.field.is_cached(rel_obj)`. `ReverseOneToOneDescriptor.get_prefetch_queryset` is guarded the same way with `self.related.field.is_cached(rel_obj)`, which covers user.profile.user. The cache is still set when it is empty.
